domain_title: Models, agents, providers, tools and supply chain
title: Unbounded or implicit agent authority
canonical_definition: An agent receives broad access and can choose independently how to exercise it without enforceable limits.

conditions: Systems that plan, call tools, retrieve resources, communicate externally or modify records.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Does the case exhibit Unbounded or implicit agent authority: An agent receives broad access and can choose independently how to exercise it without enforceable limits.
Do implemented workflows, data paths or operations show shared administrative credentials, unrestricted tool access, or model-controlled authorization?
Does current evidence test presence or scoped absence of Unbounded or implicit agent authority, or does it remain unknown?

antipattern_indicators: No approval for external messages or record changes

conditions: Refer verified unbounded or implicit agent authority to the accountable authority before progression where the condition materially affects the requested operating scope.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, MAP 3.3 (PDF p. 32), MAP 3.5 (PDF p. 32), MEASURE 2.7 (PDF p. 35)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on scoping AI use, defining oversight and evaluating security and resilience. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

failure_mechanism: The declared or implemented control can be unreliable where authority is implied by tool availability or controlled by model instructions alone. The mechanism can have an operational effect where a verified tool-call trace shows action outside the declared permission or approval envelope.
potential_consequences: An agent may trigger effects the accountable operator never authorized.

atomic_tests.test: Compare the effective governance and design records. Determine whether authority is implied by tool availability or controlled by model instructions alone. Identify the system scope and the record that supports each conclusion.

Trace actual configurations or activity for the assessed release. Determine whether a verified tool-call trace shows action outside the declared permission or approval envelope. Attribute each observation to the specific path, time and decision.

Independently review controlled denied-action and interruption checks across roles, approval states, limits and integrations. Record whether each material mechanism was tested, the observed result and the scope limitations.

required_evidence.title: Effective design and governance records
required_evidence.description: Review the versioned owner decision and relevant specifications for evidence of whether authority is implied by tool availability or controlled by model instructions alone. Preserve material conflict and applicability context.

required_evidence.title: Observed condition or enforcement trace
required_evidence.description: Use effective configuration or dated operational records to determine whether a verified tool-call trace shows action outside the declared permission or approval envelope. Identify the version, affected paths and period represented.

required_evidence.title: Executed scoped comparison
required_evidence.description: Provide controlled denied-action and interruption checks across roles, approval states, limits and integrations. Include current scope, expected results, observed results, retained evidence and unresolved cases.

required_evidence.title: Independent review and limitations
required_evidence.description: An independent reviewer confirms the assessed version, completeness of coverage, result, limitations and whether a material change requires a new test.

required_artifacts: Controlled denied-action and interruption checks across roles, approval states, limits and integrations.
Current version and scope with all material failure paths and cases identified.
Expected and observed results, attributable records, and independent review of coverage and residual limitations.

sufficiency: Presence requires affirmative evidence for a material mechanism. Examine whether authority is implied by tool availability or controlled by model instructions alone, and separately check whether a verified tool-call trace shows action outside the declared permission or approval envelope. A supported mechanism may establish presence within its evidenced scope.
Keep unresolved or contradictory mechanisms UNKNOWN and preserve the competing records. Refer material interpretation conflicts to the accountable human authority.

Use TESTED_ABSENT only after a current, executed, successful and independently verified evaluation covers all material paths within scope. Use controlled denied-action and interruption checks across roles, approval states, limits and integrations. Reassess when material changes affect that scope.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A document can identify a declared gap. Effective configuration can demonstrate a reachable condition. Observed records support only their covered period and workflow. TESTED_ABSENT requires the complete scoped absence contract.
false_positive_guards: An agent may propose an action when an external control independently enforces authorization before execution.
Confirm that the observed or alleged condition applies to the current assessed release and a reachable path.
prohibited_inferences: A gap or UNKNOWN in C3 alone cannot establish AP-C3 presence.
Missing complaints, incident silence and unsuccessful collection cannot establish absence.
Model output and tactic selection grant no authority to approve, close a finding or accept risk.

finding_definitions.title: Design or intent shows unbounded or implicit agent authority
Implementation or operating evidence shows unbounded or implicit agent authority
Presence or tested absence of unbounded or implicit agent authority is unresolved within scope
